title: finding(plugin-detail): `DetailSection` renders `section.icon`, but `detail-section`'s authoring surface declares no `icon` — one affordance the renderer honours and no author can reach
body:
Dedup keywords: `detail-section` · `DETAIL_SECTION_NODE_INPUTS` · `section.icon` · `DetailViewSection` · undeclared-input

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat while re-measuring objectui#8626 before closing it. ⛔ Unassigned and ungraded — grading is triage's. This is **not** objectui#8626's defect (that one was the flat-versus-`section` shape mismatch, repaired by PR objectui#9221) and it is **not** objectui#9218 (`showBorder` inert in the collapsible branch). It is the gap objectui#9221's acceptance notes recorded as *"Noted, not filed"*; this card is the filing, with the measurement redone.

## The measurement

At `origin/main` `bbc9dc3`.

`DetailViewSection` (`packages/types/src/views.ts`) carries **eleven** members. `DETAIL_SECTION_NODE_INPUTS` (`packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSectionNode.tsx`) declares **eight** — and the registration at `packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx:352` publishes exactly those eight as the node's `inputs`. Undeclared: `name`, `icon`, `visible`.

Reads counted off the `section` object in `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx`, with every **declared** member carried as a lit control in the same pass:

| member | `section.<m>` reads | declared? |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | 4 | yes |
| `description` | 4 | yes |
| `fields` | 8 | yes |
| `collapsible` | 2 | yes |
| `defaultCollapsed` | 1 | yes |
| `columns` | 1 | yes |
| `showBorder` | 3 | yes |
| `headerColor` | 2 | yes |
| **`icon`** | **2** | ⛔ **no** |
| `name` | 0 | no |
| `visible` | 0 | no |

⇒ eight non-zero controls in the same grep pass, so the two zeros are **readings**, not a dead pattern.

## ⭐ So the gap is exactly ONE member, not three

PR objectui#9221's note named all three undeclared members together. Re-measured, only **`icon`** is both **read by the renderer** and **unreachable by an author**. `name` and `visible` are undeclared *and* unread here, so they carry no authoring gap at this block — whatever else may be true of them, they are not this finding.

## Why it matters

The `inputs` array is not documentation. `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx` builds the JSX-page compiler's manifest from `getKnownTypes()` plus these same `inputs`, and `sdui-parser`'s `validateTree` judges an authored page against it. ⇒ the platform's own validator tells an author the eight names are the correct and **complete** way to write this block, on the one surface where the answer is machine-read — while the renderer honours a ninth.

⚠️ The failure direction is the quiet one: an author who writes `icon` is **warned**, not silently dropped (per objectui#9221's reading), so nothing breaks and nothing renders. The affordance simply cannot be reached.

## ⛔ Not pre-judged

This is a decision to **WIDEN** a published authoring surface, which is a product question and ⛔ not this seat's:

1. **Declare it** — add `{ name: 'icon', type: 'string' }` to the registration and to `DETAIL_SECTION_NODE_INPUTS`, making the renderer's affordance reachable.
2. **Stop reading it** — delete the two `section.icon` reads, making the declaration complete instead. ⚠️ In-repo callers use `DetailSection` **directly** (not through the node), so they may be authoring `icon` today; measure that before choosing this.
3. **Leave it** — accept that the node surface is deliberately narrower than the component's, and say so in the registration so the next reader does not re-file this.

⇒ option 2 is a behaviour change for direct callers and option 1 is new published surface (**clause ②**). Neither is mechanical.

## Reproduction

1. `git show origin/main:packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSectionNode.tsx | grep -A10 DETAIL_SECTION_NODE_INPUTS` — the eight.
2. `git show origin/main:packages/types/src/views.ts | awk '/interface DetailViewSection[ <{]/,/^}/'` — the eleven.
3. `git show origin/main:packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx | grep -c 'section\.icon\b'` — **2**. Run the same count for the eight declared names as controls.

## Related

- objectui#8626 — the card this came out of; its own defect is repaired and it is being closed.
- objectui#9218 — `DetailSection`'s collapsible branch never reads `section.showBorder`. Different member, different mechanism, also filed from objectui#9221.
- objectui#6955 — narrowed `headerColor`'s value vocabulary; same eight lines, different question.
